short.lead: You asked for three things: fix the out-of-date docs using the new drift check, get GitHub working, and connect your PC. The docs are mostly fixed and PlunderSpell is reachable. Your PC and the billing figures each need a step from you.
short.hint: Tap a row to see what was done and what it showed.
items: scripts/docs_drift.py found 27 citations in this repo's docs that point past the end of a file or at nothing. 21 were line numbers from before hook.py was split into modules; each now names the function and its module instead, and the drift check confirms them. The other 6 show that the checker needs three small changes: skip citations in dated log entries and on lines saying a file was deleted (they describe history), and skip shell variables such as $HERE. Those are code changes, locked while phase 2 is in QA.
Your reply in step 3 below, which unlocks code edits.

PlunderSpell is attached read-only. Its tracked files are about 1 GB in a shallow clone; the largest is a 24.8 MB speech-recognition library, so no file there is over the 50 MB limit, and .claude/worktrees/ is already ignored. So the 153 GB on your PC is not in git. The drift check found 2 real problems in its docs: alarm.md:326 cites CombatState.cs:228 in a 223-line file, and raid.md:203 cites a CastleGuard.cs that no longer exists. Another repo's work becomes an issue there, not a change from here.
Cloud sessions may only call GitHub for their own repositories, so the billing figures can't be read from here. A session on your PC can, with your own gh login.
Nothing yet; I test it once your PC is connected.
This cloud environment adds that line to everything it posts to GitHub, and it can't be turned off from a cloud session. Sessions on your PC that post with your own gh login don't add it.
Nothing; use a session on your PC where it matters.
No folder is shared with this session yet

This session can only use folders your PC shares through Remote Control, and none are shared, so it can't connect. Using a folder from a cloud session is not available to every account yet, so it may not appear even after you add one.
